prompt: Why is leaving the roller shade down unsuitable for the demonstration?
promptZh: 為什麼不適合在示範時一直放下捲簾？

options.text: The streak gets brighter with the shade down.
options.zh: 捲簾放下時亮紋更明顯。
options.whyZh: 捲簾放下後亮紋反而消失。

options.text: Customers would have trouble seeing the samples.
options.whyZh: 捲簾讓樣品太暗，但明天必須看得清楚樣品。

options.text: The shade blocks the view from beside the screen.
options.zh: 捲簾會擋住靠螢幕旁的視線。
options.whyZh: 記錄的是變暗，沒有說捲簾擋住視線。

options.text: There will be no samples to show.
options.whyZh: 主管明確說樣品必須看得清楚。

explanationZh: 捲簾讓樣品太暗，但明天必須看得清楚樣品。
evidence: the shade also made the display samples too dark | the samples must remain visible

vocabulary.note: 可收起或放下遮光的窗簾。

difficultyRationale: 以追蹤說明中的實際副作用連結活動限制。
